Maintain current operation; fault is monitored under NORMAL mode as temperatures are below safety limit and within allowed ranges.

Reduce proportional gain in zone0 to 2 %/°C and increase integral time to 300 s, lowering heater demand so predicted temperature stays within 1.5 °C of the 50 °C setpoint while respecting Kc (0.5‑20) and tauI (20‑600) limits.
Maintain current operation under NORMAL mode; no parameter changes are permitted, only monitoring.
Force heater shutdown to avoid predicted overshoot while staying in the required NORMAL mode; this brings heater output to 0 % and keeps temperature within safety and regulation limits.
